rejectedTopics: CPU versus TPU dumbbells — overlaps the existing rubber-versus-urethane and material guides.
Container loading optimization — overlaps the export-packaging and landed-cost guides.
Dumbbell weight tolerance alone — existing weighed-dumbbell and tolerance content already covers the main intent.
General pre-shipment inspection — already published in every active locale.
Cable weld inspection alone — overlaps compatibility and load-path guides and lacks a distinct broad buyer decision gap.
siteGaps: No existing article defined how a buyer converts consequences into critical, major and minor findings across mixed free-weight SKUs, or how rejection, containment and reinspection should be documented.

searchRun.provider: Public Google and Bing result review, Reddit buyer-language review, competitor review and direct primary-source verification
limitations: Quora blocked automated access; no answer text was used.
Reddit supplied buyer language only; standards claims rely on ISO and ASQ.
ISO table values are not reproduced because buyers must select the purchased standard edition and contractual plan.
No customer, shipment, price, MOQ, certification or performance result was inferred from public pages.
